nodes.title: Generate - stage 1
widgets_values:
## Generate - stage 1

**Sampler - Distilled (8 steps)**

This takes the distilled ltx-2.5 model and runs the diffusion in 8 steps. You can change the noise seed, the guider cfg (used for both video and audio) and select the sampler.

nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Make sure to adjust the number of tiles and overlap to fit your hardware.
(fewer tiles will result in faster execution, but will require more memory).

### Recommended settings

| node settings (pixels)                     | resolved latent geometry        |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `512 / 64 / 128 / 32`                      | 16×16, ov 2 | 16f, ov 4         |
| `768 / 192 / 128 / 32`                     | 24×24, ov 6 | 16f, ov 4         |
| `1024 / 256 / 128 / 48`                    | 32×32, ov 8 | 16f, ov 6         |
| `1536 / 384 / 192 / 48`                    | 48×48, ov 12 | 24f, ov 6        |
| `768 / 192 / spatial-only`                 | 24×24, ov 6 | no temporal split |

nodes.title: Generate - stage 2
widgets_values:
## Generate - stage 2

**Upscale and re-sampler (3 steps)**

This subgraph node upscales the result of the first stage by 2 (width & height) and runs another 3 steps of diffusion after adding noise on the input latent. You can adjust the noise seed and the sampler/guider used in this diffusion stage. The original image is used here again for conditioning, if you entered one.

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ Audio VAE - ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)

- Video VAE - one of these:
  - [ Diffusion decoder ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) - Best quality
  - [ Convolutional decoder - ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors) - Lower memory & faster

- [ Upscaler - ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/latent_upscale_models/ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors)



**Text Encoder - finetuned for LTX-2.5**
- [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors)

**Text Enhancer**
- [Google Gemma 4 E2B IT](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/gemma-4/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors)


**Model Storage Location**

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │      ├── gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors
│   │      └── gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors / ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 latent_upscale_models/
│          └── ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors
```

## Report Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

**Native HDR:** use float32 video VAE path (node in graph). EXR plates require OpenImageIO (`pip install openimageio`).

nodes.title: Native HDR EXR
widgets_values:
## Native HDR I2V

EXR still → ACEScct → float32 VAE → two-stage distilled I2V → EXR + HLG out (same I/O as pipelines `--hdr` on Distilled).
Not the SDR→HDR IC-LoRA upgrade path.

widgets_values_named.text:
## Native HDR I2V

EXR still → ACEScct → float32 VAE → two-stage distilled I2V → EXR + HLG out (same I/O as pipelines `--hdr` on Distilled).
Not the SDR→HDR IC-LoRA upgrade path.

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

**Video dimensions**

adjust video width and video height to determine the output dimensions.


**Image conditioning (native HDR)**

Set **img_strength = 1.0** to fully lock the EXR plate.

Set **img_compression = 0**. For SDR I2V, Comfy JPEG-recompresses the conditioning frame (CRF) to match training. Native HDR EXR skips that in Python pipelines — JPEG on ACEScct codes darkens highlights. Use 0 here.

nodes.title: Save video
widgets_values:
## Save HDR

1. **LTXVHDRDecodePostprocess** (`transfer=acescct`) — EXR + `hdr_linear`.
2. **LTXVSaveHLG** — BT.2020/HLG 10-bit master (muxes Decode **AUDIO**).
3. Preview: CreateVideo → SaveVideo from `hdr_linear` + Decode AUDIO.

nodes.title: Inputs
widgets_values:
## Inputs (Native HDR I2V)

**Required:** **Load EXR still** — a single `.exr` plate (or folder; first frames load). Set `color_space` to match the plate (`srgb_linear` / `acescg` / `acescct`).

Set **fps** and **duration** as usual for I2V (they control generated length).

Prompts / API key remain optional.

**Length:** fps=24 and duration=5 → `1 + floor(24*5/8)*8` = **121** frames. If you still get 161/193, the frame-count math is being overridden — reload this workflow JSON.
